route.district_rule: Each fork has one offer leading to each lane; within a committed lane still show three encounters. Favoured eligible formations have weight 2, others 1. Borrow from opening templates to keep a simpler Regular alternative; never add a robot or bypass a gate. Position 7 is the shared junction encounter, not a free encounter.
route.history_rule: Default packet for the first Cable Binder exposure; its authored alternate becomes eligible only after the default has been introduced. Prior formation exclusion applies only when enough distinct legal Regular templates remain. Preserve at least one simpler first-exposure option.
route.save_rule: Persist the whole schedule, resolved offers, district commitment, encounter seed and exposed mechanics. Lane changes, shopping and reopening cannot reroll them.

formations.source_fragment: One Rivet Mite C1-R01 + Breach Ram R02

C1-R04.variant_gate: Prior default-packet exposure; select only at packet boundaries.

C1-R07.selection_rule: Select Deploy only when no Mite is alive and supply remains, otherwise Attack; freeze the selected intent. A committed Deploy cannot become an Attack if its condition changes before resolution.

summons.clock: Committed Deploy action; when no live Mite and supply remains

mysteries.name: Backlot Patrol
mysteries.player_text: A patrol blocks the scrap-yard exit. Read its intent and break through.
mysteries.result: Use the current legal Regular formation and default/previously introduced patterns. Ordinary Regular cores and recipe rewards; never an Officer or boss. The completed fight counts this Mystery node once and restocks once through its result receipt. Defeat ends the campaign normally.
mysteries.acceptance: The saved Mystery reveals a legal current-band Regular formation, resumes the same fight-entry seed and advances one route position only after completion.

mysteries.name: Night Exchange
mysteries.player_text: A salvager opens a locked stockcase. The listed items are yours to inspect; buying is optional.

event_stock.price_source: beta shop prices and current owned discounts

mysteries.result: Purchases are optional and individually receipted. A recipe exchange and payment commit together or neither changes. Leaving grants 10 salvage Credits once, subject to UGS-113's optional replacement. Remaining event stock expires; ordinary shop stock and purchases remain unchanged. No heal and no combat-victory hooks.
mysteries.acceptance: Reload preserves every price, candidate, purchase and completion receipt. Returning to the ordinary shop does not refresh it; leaving this Mystery advances once.

mysteries.name: Field Calibration
mysteries.player_text: A field technician can fit one recovered system using your emergency tissue supply. Inspect its function and full HP cost, or decline.
mysteries.result: Show at most three distinct eligible never-acquired Mystery-source upgrades; current city/mercenary and each item's literal selection/payment requirements apply. All required current-HP costs together must leave at least 1 HP. Accept zero or one. An impossible or exhausted upgrade offer retains Decline. Complete once with 10 salvage Credits, subject to UGS-113's optional replacement; no shop restock or combat-victory hooks.
mysteries.acceptance: At 8 HP a flat 8-HP offer is disabled and spends nothing. At 9 HP it leaves 1 before its acquisition payload. An item with an additional 8-HP cost requires 17 HP. Decline is always available and saved offers never reroll.

authored_tuning.status: Assistant-authored implementation content under the approved complete-city scope; hypotheses, not played balance or additional owner decisions.
authored_tuning.district_names: Retain the progression document's functional Foundry/Patrol/Workshop lanes. Reuse those lane identities at the second fork; no new travel system.
authored_tuning.mystery_prices_and_rewards: Night Exchange uses existing price rules and source eligibility. Its rarity weights, the flat 8-current-HP calibration payment and 10-Credit noncombat salvage are initial content tuning.
authored_tuning.nested_ordinary_recipe_offers: UGS-089's unspecified ordinary acquisition offers use current-city Regular recipe rarity weights. They remain acquisition offers rather than combat-victory triggers.
authored_tuning.ordinary_upgrade_exhaustion: A mandatory ordinary upgrade offer with no eligible unowned item grants 30 Credits instead, matching UGS-150's authored exhaustion amount. A shop suppresses an empty slot. Field Calibration keeps its free Decline and charges no HP. UGS-113 keeps the normal Credit reward. No Mayor item leaks into ordinary pools.
authored_tuning.playtest_question: Do Cinderwall's visible intents and rewards make the player change what they craft, save, install and fire? In Mysteries, can they explain the cost and why they accepted or declined?
